name: assistant
summary: A page with Claude capabilities enabled out of the box: a Work with Claude pane (pick a block, say what you want, send it to a watching Claude Code session or ask now), a Requests view that follows every request, a line saying whether a session is watching, and every catalog theme with a switch in the header.
use_when: Any shared artifact where people should be able to point at a part of the page and have Claude change it, answer about it or fix it, without leaving the page.
